title: PMI procedure
note: AI draft, engineer to confirm. DRAFT written by Claude from the rule books the library holds (order 14 lane P): each element cites its book, clause and page, and a held book's quote was checked by code on that stored page (scripts/playbook_quote_check.py, the quote check of gate G1). An element whose book is not held keeps its clause and reads 'book missing'. The cue words are a starting point, not a finding; a client discipline engineer confirms or changes every element before it is signed off. Scope (SAES-A-206 1): positive material identification of pressure-retaining alloys and their welds.

elements.title: Testing and reporting covered
elements.expects: The procedure covers how PMI testing is done and how its results are reported.

source.quote: shall implement a written PMI Procedure, covering testing and reporting

elements.title: Extent of testing
elements.expects: The procedure states which materials and components are tested and how many (100 % or a sample).

source.quote: PMI testing shall be performed on all pressure components and welds of alloy materials

elements.title: Weld metal and filler metal
elements.expects: The procedure tests the weld metal (and the filler metal) as well as the base material.

source.quote: PMI testing of weld metal shall be subjected to the same coverage as for the base material.

elements.title: Instrument and method
elements.expects: The procedure names the PMI instrument and method (for example XRF or OES) and what it can detect.

source.quote: The primary acceptable method is X-ray emission analysis

elements.title: Operator qualification and training
elements.expects: The procedure requires trained, qualified instrument operators and keeps their training records.

source.quote: instrument operators shall be qualified to operate approved equipment

elements.title: Calibration and its frequency
elements.expects: The procedure says how the instrument is calibrated or verified with certified standards, and how often.

source.quote: shall specify the frequency interval for this calibration

elements.title: Surface preparation
elements.expects: The procedure says how the test surface is prepared (clean bare metal, grinding where the method needs it).

source.quote: The surface to be analyzed shall be clean bare metal, free of grease or oil

elements.title: Acceptance criteria
elements.expects: The procedure states the acceptance criteria for the measured alloying elements.

source.quote: Alloys shall be acceptable if the alloying elements are each within

elements.title: Rejected items segregated and marked
elements.expects: The procedure segregates and marks rejected components so they are not used.

source.quote: Procedures shall be in place to ensure that rejected components are segregated

elements.title: Test log
elements.expects: The procedure keeps a log of each component and weld tested with its results.

source.quote: The log shall identify all components and welds that have been alloy-verified and the results of testing.

elements.title: PMI map
elements.expects: The procedure prepares a PMI map showing each alloy component and the extent of testing.

source.quote: The manufacturer shall prepare a detailed PMI map

elements.title: Final PMI report
elements.expects: The procedure produces a final PMI testing report for the data book.

source.quote: shall prepare a complete PMI Testing Report containing all relevant data

elements.title: Marking of accepted material
elements.expects: The procedure marks accepted material and welds as PMI tested.

source.quote: All verified materials with an acceptable analysis shall be marked with the letters
